author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: जीववदशुभभोगोऽप्यस्ति किमित्यतः शुभानेव भुङ्क्त इति वदन्कुतो नोपलभ्यत इति शङ्कां निराह ॥ उत्क्रामंतमिति । गुणान्वितं शुभयुक्तमेवेत्यर्थः । विमूढा इत्यनुपलंभे हेतूक्तिः ॥ १५.१०॥
translation:
Departing, or standing within, or enjoying only what is excellent-Him the deluded do not perceive; those endowed with the eve of wisdom do see. (10.)
V. Gunanvita: united to excellence that which is excellent. The deluded: furnishes the reason for their not perceiving Him.
A. How is it that perception does not arise in spite of the efforts made ?
